name: spring-thymeleaf-a11y
description: Accessibility audit, fix guidance, and safe autofix workflows for Spring Boot and Thymeleaf applications.

interface.shortDescription: Audit and repair accessibility issues in Thymeleaf apps
interface.longDescription: Run Playwright and axe-core accessibility audits against Spring Boot and Thymeleaf flows, generate Thymeleaf-specific remediation guidance, and optionally step through safe autofix loops.
defaultPrompt: Run an accessibility audit for this Spring Boot and Thymeleaf app.
Summarize the latest axe accessibility report and map it to Thymeleaf fixes.
Prepare a safe autofix plan and rerun loop for this accessibility audit.
